chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said: To God, Mighty and Majestic, sending blessings upon Muhammad and his family is equal to glorification (tasbih), pronouncing His oneness (tahlil), and exaltation (takbir).

key_terms.التسبيح: Tasbih — glorification of God by saying 'SubhanAllah' (Glory be to God)
key_terms.التكبير: Takbir — exaltation of God by saying 'Allahu Akbar' (God is the greatest)
key_terms.التهليل: Tahlil — pronouncing divine oneness by saying 'La ilaha illa Allah' (There is no god but God)

ai.seo_question: Is salawat equal in reward to tasbih, tahlil, and takbir according to Imam al-Rida?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (AS) declares that in God's estimation, sending blessings upon Muhammad and his family (salawat) is equivalent in reward to three foundational forms of dhikr: tasbih (saying 'SubhanAllah' — glory be to God), tahlil (saying 'La ilaha illa Allah' — there is no god but God), and takbir (saying 'Allahu Akbar' — God is the greatest). This elevates salawat from a supplementary devotion to the spiritual rank of the most essential forms of remembrance of God.
